title: roles.json
description: The five seat roles. prd_may_change and prd_may_read are the PRD's Roles table cells, verbatim; operations are the agent calls a seat of the role may make, which are the registry operations whose caller is one of callers; acts_as names the roles whose work a seat of the role does (a General seat does the work of the other four, contract decision GA-1); role_file says whether its briefing and its jobs' material carry a role file (none for a General seat, GA-2); job_rules are the rules, as plain sentences, that the job material of a seat with no role file carries instead, and that the runner's job prompts, the join text and the eval's General mode give it (GA-7): empty for a role with a role file.

acts_as.description: The roles whose work a seat of this role does: itself, or every other role for General.

role_file.description: Whether a seat of this role gets its role file, api/config/role_files/<role>.md.

work_rules.description: The instructions a General seat gets in its build or review briefing and join text.

job_rules.description: The rules a job material gives a seat of this role in place of a role file (GA-7), in order; empty when role_file is true.
